description: Rove is a supervised browser for AI agents: the agent drives a real Chromium browser through the MCP server, and a human can watch live through a one-time viewer link, take exclusive control, and hand it back — the agent re-reads the page before acting again. Cline users building or debugging anything web-facing get browser automation their agent can be supervised on, instead of an unsupervised headless session. Rove is already published on the official MCP Registry as io.github.noncelogic/rove with a hosted remote endpoint, and ships as the npm package @roveapi/mcp.
name: Rove
tagline: Supervised browser for AI agents — a human can watch live, take control, and hand it back.
